Native macOS Docker client: containers, images and volumes over the Docker daemon's
event stream. Start, stop, restart and remove containers, pull and run images, remove
volumes, `DOCKER_HOST` / context / socket discovery, and a header that says plainly when
the engine is down.

Install:

    brew install adgan/tap/contui

The bottle is arm64 macOS 26 (Tahoe) only. Ad-hoc signed, not notarized: the first launch
may need right-click → Open.
